programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: (2004) All-action thriller. Queen Latifah stars as the driver of the fastest taxi in New York, who teams up with an inept cop (Jimmy Fallon) to catch a team of female bank-robbers.

programme.title: The Dive

programme.title: Underwater

programme.title: Crawl
programme.desc: (2019) Soggy, snappy reptilian horror with Kaya Scodelario. A talented swimmer must use her water-based skills to evade a congregation of alligators during a flood.

programme.title: Real
programme.desc: (2019) Heartfelt romantic drama. In Portsmouth, a new couple hide their real, working-class circumstances from each other and invent alternate lives. Can their love survive the truth?

programme.title: Adventures of a Private Eye
programme.desc: 1977. Comedy. Director: Stanley Long. Stars Chris Neil, Suzy Kendall, Harry H. Corbett. While his boss is away, Bob helps a model being blackmailed, finds a dead body & ends up in a cabaret club.

programme.title: The Heritage Chart Show with Mike Read
programme.desc: A TOTP style TV Show for Heritage Artists based on the Heritage Chart which is voted on in over 80 countries. Songs you love from popular artists, live and on video with the odd interview.

programme.title: Be My Guest
programme.desc: 1965. Comedy. Directed by Lance Comfort. Stars Steve Marriott, David Hemmings, Andrea Monet. Dave, ex-member of pop group 'The Smart Alecs', meets Erica, an attractive young woman seeking fame.

programme.title: Dead Gorgeous
programme.desc: 2002. Drama/Comedy. Directed by Sarah Harding. Stars Fay Ripley, Helen McCrory & Ron Cook. In post-war London, a chance meeting between two old friends sets off a murderous chain of events.

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: The Coming of Robin Hood. 1955. Stars Richard Greene, Victor Woolf & Alan Wheatley. When Robin of Locksley returns home from the Holy Land, he finds Normans are in control everywhere.

programme.title: The Buccaneers
programme.desc: Blackbeard. 1956. Stars Alec Clunes, George Margo & Peter Hammond. Blackbeard becomes suspicious when a new governor arrives in the Bahamas and offers the pirates pardons from the King.

programme.title: Strange But True
programme.desc: Pilot - UFO Sightings/Reincarnation. 1993. Michael Aspel introduces stories of the unexplained; this episode looks at UFO sightings in West Yorkshire and a woman who believes she was reincarnated.

programme.title: Johnny Ringo
programme.desc: The Vindicator. Directed by Aaron Spelling. Staring Don Durant. Brad, a young ranch hand who was celebrating his 21st birthday, was arrested for the murder of the wife of an escaped convict.

programme.title: A Woman's Temptation
programme.desc: 1959. Drama. Director: Godfrey Grayson. Stars Patricia Driscoll, Robert Ayres & John Pike. A widow struggling as a single mother is tempted by stolen money, but the thieves return to find it.

programme.title: The Crowded Day
programme.desc: 1954. Drama. Director: John Guillermin. Stars Joan Rice, Josephine Griffin, Freda Jackson. The story of the ups and downs of a group of salesgirls at a department store in the run up to Christmas.

programme.title: What's On TPTV With Noel
programme.desc: Founder of Talking Pictures TV and one half of the Footage Detectives, Noel Cronin, shares shows and films not to be missed throughout January.

programme.title: The Man in Black
programme.desc: 1950. Thriller. Director: Francis Searle. Stars Betty Ann Davies, Sheila Burrell, Sid James. After a man's untimely death, his second wife tries to drive his daughter insane to inherit his estate.

programme.title: The Drum
programme.desc: 1938. War. Directed by Zoltan Korda. Stars Sabu, Raymond Massey & Roger Livesey. When the Khan of Tokot is murdered, his killer, the evil Prince Ghul, plots an uprising against British rule.

programme.title: A Matter of Murder
programme.desc: 1949. Crime. Directed by John Gilling. Stars Maureen Riscoe, John Barry & John Le Mesurier. A bank clerk becomes the target of a killer and a detective after embezzling money for his girlfriend.

programme.title: The Big Job
programme.desc: 1965. Comedy. A gang of crooks are caught on a big job. 15 years later they find their loot is now buried under a police station. Stars Sidney James, Sylvia Syms, Dick Emery & Joan Sims.

programme.title: The Break
programme.desc: 1963. Crime Drama. Director: Lance Comfort. When writer Greg Parker (Tony Britton) goes on holiday, little does he expect to be lodging in the same B&B as an escaped murderer (William Lucas).

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Silent Thunder. 1960. Stars Michael Landon, Albert Salmi & Stella Stevens. Little Joe teaches a deaf girl sign language after she is treated poorly by her father, but she ends up falling for him.

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: Double Pay Off. 1955. Stars Ron Randell, Howard Pays & Robert Raikes. Eric plans a clever robbery but it is soon revealed he has fallen victim to a gang. Will there be a double pay off of fate?

programme.title: The Footage Detectives
programme.desc: Step back into the 70s with Mike and Noel for a wonderful reel showing the holiday of a lifetime. After this, have a hilarious peak at the Ford V8 and watch Mario Pietro in concert!

programme.title: The Racing Game
programme.desc: Horsenap. 1979. Stars Mike Gwilym, Mick Ford & Iain Cuthbertson. A famous racehorse is kidnapped but no ransom demands are made. Sid and Chico are called on to find the horse and bring him home.

programme.title: Gideon's Way
programme.desc: The Tin God. Stars John Gregson Alexander Davion and Daphne Anderson. Two criminals make a murderous escape from prison with a carefully executed plan.

programme.title: The Anderson Tapes (1971)
programme.desc: 1971. Crime Thriller. Directed by Sidney Lumet. Starring Martin Balsam, Dyan Cannon, Sean Connery, Christopher Walken. A habitual criminal looks for funding to set up his next robbery.

programme.title: A Good Read: Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: A Scandal in Bohemia. Enjoy this classic short story read by Mike Read where Sherlock Holmes is asked by the King of Bohemia to retrieve an incriminating photo which could ruin his engagement.

programme.title: Across The Bridge
